title: Games
description:
S1
A mysterious woman (Simone Signoret) in black moves in with married Manhattan thrill-seekers (James Caan, Katharine Ross) and helps one trick the other.

title: Gone
description:
S1
A televangelist (Gregory Itzin) influences a confrontational man (Billy Burke) motivated by revenge.

title: The Green Inferno
description:
S1
Student activists (Lorenza Izzo, Ariel Levy) crash-land in the Amazon and encounter an indigenous tribe of cannibals who'd like to have them for dinner.

title: The Guardian
description:
S1
Yuppies (Dwier Brown, Carey Lowell) with a baby hire a nanny (Jenny Seagrove), a druid witch who sacrifices babies to a tree.

title: The Hitcher II: I've Been Waiting
description:
S1
A psychopathic hitchhiker (Jake Busey) terrorizes a man (C. Thomas Howell) and his girlfriend (Kari Wuhrer) as they take a road trip.

title: I Saw What You Did
description:
S1
Two teenage girls, bored while baby-sitting, make prank phone calls, completely unaware one of the people on the other end of the line has just killed his wife and now thinks the girls must be silenced.

title: Incarnate
description:
S1
Recruited by a Vatican emissary (Catalina Sandino Moreno), an exorcist (Aaron Eckhart) taps into the subconscious mind of a tormented boy (David Mazouz) to free him from demonic possession.

title: Karma
description:
S1
When recent college grad Manny has trouble making ends meet, his father-in-law offers him a job evicting delinquent tenants. Manny soon finds himself unleashing a karma demon which stalks him at every turn.

title: The Keeping Hours
description:
S1
A lawyer sees the ghost of his dead son, which leads the man's estranged wife back into his life.

title: Killer High
description:
S1
Sabrina's perfectly planned high school reunion goes south when a monster keeps killing all the guests.

title: Boogeyman
description:
S1
Mike (Eddie McClintock), the town sheriff, has to battle the mythical Boogeyman after boys accidentally release it.

title: Long Time Dead
description:
S1
A genie terrorizes London students (Lara Belmont, Melanie Gutteridge) after they unwittingly summon it with a Ouija.
